name: Werewolf
generous: Use the Knockback of Maul to turn off the Werewolves' Pack Hunter ability. Maul 2 different targets rather than attacking a Prone one.
deadly: Knock heroes into their own allies, or knockback to increase Wereboar's Charge damage or adjacent to allied Werewolves, giving them Advantage 2 (Prone + Pack Hunter).

name: Nightmare
generous: Charge through your enemies, ending with them outside your aura.
deadly: Have a rider engage from atop the Nightmare. Vampires or Fiends make for a good combination.

name: Flesh Golem
generous: Telegraph your slow speed, allow enemies to kite you.
deadly: Pretend to be a dead body, surprising enemies that draw near. Engage in an enclosed space, or with Grappling allies (e.g., an animated rug).

name: Autumn Golem
generous: Aim scythe attacks to hit only 1 or 2 targets.
deadly: Have an ally or minion intentionally set the Golem ablaze.

name: Drow Scout
generous: Stay near melee heroes to be easily dispatched.
deadly: Shoot from max Range. Spread out Poison then focus fire.

name: Drow Warrior
generous: Use the Poisoned Crossbow for less damage output
deadly: Use Blade Flurry VS Hampered targets for tremendous damage output!

name: Drow Arachnomancer
generous: Move out into the open and use Fanglash on already Poisoned Heroes. Allow Web Wall to disappear when bloodied, crit or at will.
deadly: Use Web Wall to split up the party of heroes, and target low HP heroes with Pyrotoxin at max Range.

name: Drow Elite Warrior
generous: Act first and target non-Hampered heroes
deadly: Act last and prioritize Hampered heroes.

name: Drider
generous: Knock creatures Prone before attacking with Ranged Drow.
deadly: Follow up Drider attacks with Warrior's Blade Flurry.

name: Drow Priestess
generous: Avoid movement, move minions in groups, toward heroes that have AoE abilities that can easily take them out. Minions act next round.
deadly: Minions act immediately, spread them out so that multiple are not easily taken out with single attacks.

name: Ooh, Shiny!
generous: Target just a couple strong-willed heroes.
deadly: Target the max number of heroes. Combine this with your cave in trap for maximum effectiveness.

name: Fungusfolk Sentinel
generous: Don't retreat. Target heroes adjacent to you and don't spend their action moving.
deadly: Continually withdraw to advantageous terrain. Force heroes to take damage pursuing.

name: Fungusfolk Psychotrope
generous: Move heroes randomly or safely while Hallucinating.
deadly: Stay close to Sentinels, make heroes retreat out of their reach while Hallucinating, or into other hazards.

name: Fungusfolk Sovereign
generous: Command a Sentinal to wast its Daze on an already Dazed hero, make a hero without any actions hallucinate.
deadly: Stay out of reach and command from cover or even a completely different cave system!

name: Deep Spider Tactics
generous: Web up targets from a distance and and move in one by one. Let heroes target you one at a time.
deadly: Use traps or terrain for cover as you shoot web, have allies Hamper weak heroes and immediately bite!

name: Grick Tactics
generous: Grasp martial heroes with tentacles—but save the beak only for those that can take it.
deadly: Swarm targets with Wormlets to set up powerful beak attacks for their bigger kin. Wormlets may be easy to escape, but it still takes an action!

name: Umber Hulk
generous: Use Confusion to move heroes around, rather than attack.
deadly: Bait heroes around corners and into tight corridors, where they can't escape your pheromones. Pit confused heroes against each other, or make them Interpose for you.

name: Deep Giants
generous: Club carelessly, hitting allies. Dramatically curse heroes that damage you, even at close range.
deadly: Curse heroes using cover, or ones that are often buffed or in need of aid. Use chokepoints to funnel heroes into one big Club Sweep. Knock heroes back into tight clumps for better follow up attacks.

name: Cloaker
generous: Release targets in surprise when hit.
deadly: If your Grapple target breaks free, fly out of reach and Wail. Then, Wrap a distant target.

name: Great Worm
generous: Gorge yourself! Once most heroes are swallowed, your HP will melt away.
deadly: Swallow only targets that can easily bypass your armor anyway, then use Crush to slow down their friends' actions.

name: Troglodyte Muckthrower
deadly: Further debilitate foes, adding the Blinded condition gives the Trogs an additional instance of advantage against the Heroes.

name: Troglodyte Screecher
deadly: Greatly increase the survivability of the Trogs, and if positioned well can output as much damage as Champions. There is no need to have Screechers in an encounter that also has a Swollen One, their effects are redundant and can't be combined.

name: Troglodyte Champion
deadly: The only armored Troglodyte! Use them at higher levels to increase the challenge level without too greatly multiplying the number of monsters. Remember to keep the ratio of monsters to heroes no higher than 4 to 1 (minions excluded) for typical encounters.

name: Troglodyte Swollen One
deadly: These should act first, to help position Trogs deeper into the heroes' back lines, as well as to reduce the actions the heroes can take and their effectiveness by Dazing and Poisoning them. Trogs should mercilessly attack any who approach their revered Swollen Ones.

name: Gloom Moth
deadly: Always remains airborne, out of reach of melee attacks. They are particularly nasty with Champions—changing EACH of their d6s to d12s! Ranged attacks are also much more difficult to land due to the lower light radius, heroes will need to figure out a way to better light the battlefield, or possibly use wind attacks to push the Gloommoth away! Any effect that depends on sound (e.g., Commander's Orders, Songweaver's Inspiration & Vicious Mockery) is likewise limited.

name: Zombie
generous: Take the most direct line to target, regardless of danger.
deadly: Act first to Grapple and setup strong attacks from allies.

name: Ghoul
generous: Act first, targeting already Dazed heroes or ones who have not yet Defended this round.
deadly: Act last, targeting heroes who are Grappled, Prone, or not already Dazed.

name: Ogre Zombie
generous: Act last so other monsters can't take advantage of heroes being knocked Prone.
deadly: Attack Grappled heroes.

name: Giant Zombie
generous: Target ranged heroes in the open to minimize the negative effects of Knockback.
deadly: Target melee heroes near walls or their allies.

name: Flaming Skull
generous: Center Fireblast on yourself! Don't move while laughing.
deadly: Keep your distance, or distract with minions while you charge yourself.

name: Specter
generous: Attack only heroes who haven't yet Defend this round.
deadly: Stay in the air, out of melee reach. Target heroes who have already defended—multiple Specters gets deadly, fast!

name: Ghost
generous: Move the possessed hero, or make basic attacks. Allow the party to RP with you, and be convinced to act on their behalf.
deadly: Use reactions so the possessed hero can't. Interpose for monsters, negating an ally's attack.

name: Wraith
generous: Attack unwounded heroes who have not yet defended.
deadly: Focus on heroes who area already Dying, or isolated ones with no allies to Interpose for them.

name: Banshee
generous: Wail from afar, before moving in. Give the heroes time to stabilize.
deadly: Frighten and avoid melee heroes. Wail in the middle of the heroes, then immediately follow up on anyone who fails.

name: Death Knight Tactics
generous: Use Gravewalk for simple mobility during your turn, or get closer to back rank Ranged or undamaged heroes. Move out of Interpose Range of your Squires.
deadly: Save Gravewalk for when you are attacked or when a hero is being healed outside of your Aura's radius to stifle the healing and deal damage instead. That'll make the heroes respect you!

name: Grave Crow
generous: Clump up and attack heavily armored or high-health heroes that can easily shrug off their meager damage.
deadly: Spread out and attack Dying heroes to inflict Wounds more quickly.

name: Grave Squire
generous: Clump up, and Interpose against small attacks, or push Knights into disadvantageous positions when Interposing.
deadly: Spread out to avoid AoE damage, Interpose only against attacks that would bypass a Knight's Armor or other above average attacks.

name: Hollow Knight
generous: Focus on front line heroes who don't rely on crits or additional modifies for their damage.
deadly: Use your speed to focus on back line heroes and classes that need crits or modifiers to deal extra damage.

name: Cranial Hound
generous: Use Seed Thought to make heroes run away, then chase after them next turn!
deadly: Partner with Psionic Scourges or Despots. Rush in, Daze heroes, and use Seed Thought to move them towards your masters to finish off.

name: Psionic Scourge
generous: Engage heroes 1-on-1 using Psi Blast, use Seed Though to move heroes randomly.
deadly: Gang up with allies, Grapple the heroes they leave Dazed!

name: Cerebral Hulks
generous: Refrain from moving your Grappled target.
deadly: Immediately retreat with a Grappled creature to a Psionic Scourge or Despot for the finishing blow.

name: Psionic Despot
generous: Take a break on the back lines - issue psychic commands to your forces, and psychic taunts to the heroes.
deadly: Have allies isolate a hero with Seed Thought or Bring to Master, then, Consume!

name: Gibbering Mouther
generous: Choose another enemy to be struck, or choose randomly.
deadly: Force heroes to attack allies or self when confused.
